resources.title: Digital Signal Processing Transforms & Filter Design Cheatsheet
resources.description: Original study guide covering DFT vs FFT butterfly algorithms, Z-Transform properties, Butterworth vs Chebyshev IIR filters, and FIR window techniques.
resources.bestFor: DSP midterms, final exams, and GATE ECE

resources.title: Signals & Systems Convolution, Fourier & Laplace Summary
resources.description: Original formulas and derivation reference covering continuous vs discrete convolution, Fourier Series, CTFT/DTFT pairs, and ROC stability rules.
resources.bestFor: Quick formula lookup and exam preparation

resources.title: CMOS VLSI Design Timing Analysis & Layout Guidelines
resources.description: Original handbook on CMOS inverter VTC characteristics, Elmore delay calculation, Setup and Hold time constraints, Clock skew, and Lambda design rules.
resources.bestFor: VLSI design interviews and core hardware job tests

resources.title: NPTEL Digital Signal Processing by IIT Delhi
resources.description: Prof. S. C. Dutta Roy classic video lectures on Discrete Fourier Transform, Z-Transforms, digital filter realization, and sampling theorems.
resources.bestFor: Mathematical rigour in digital signal processing

resources.title: NPTEL Basic Electronics and Analog Circuits by IIT Kharagpur
resources.description: Lectures by Prof. Chitralekha Mahanta covering Diode circuits, BJT small-signal models, MOSFET amplifiers, and Op-Amp applications.
resources.bestFor: Analog circuit analysis and amplifier design

resources.title: NPTEL Signals and Systems by IIT Kanpur
resources.description: Prof. K. S. Venkatesh complete series covering LTI systems, impulse response, Fourier transform, and frequency response analysis.
resources.bestFor: Core Signals and Systems conceptual clarity

resources.title: MIT 6.002 Circuits and Electronics
resources.description: Prof. Anant Agarwal legendary MIT course on lumped circuit abstraction, MOSFET amplifiers, operational amplifiers, and energy storage.

resources.title: NPTEL VLSI Design by IIT Bombay
resources.description: Prof. A. N. Chandorkar covering MOS transistors, CMOS inverter, combinational & sequential logic design, and semiconductor memory.
resources.bestFor: VLSI design theory and CMOS circuit principles

resources.title: Neso Academy Digital Electronics Playlist
resources.description: Comprehensive tutorial playlist on Boolean Algebra, Logic Gates, K-Maps, Adders/Subtractors, Multiplexers, Latches, and Flip-Flops.
resources.bestFor: Digital logic design exams and viva questions

resources.title: NPTEL Principles of Digital Communications by IIT Kanpur
resources.description: Lectures on baseband transmission, matched filters, intersymbol interference, Nyquist criterion, and modulation schemes (BPSK, QPSK, QAM).
resources.bestFor: Digital communication theory and GATE prep

resources.title: NPTEL Microprocessors and Microcontrollers by IIT Kharagpur
resources.description: Prof. Santanu Chattopadhyay covering 8085/8086 architecture, instruction sets, assembly programming, 8051 microcontroller, and interfacing chips.

resources.title: NPTEL Antennas and Wave Propagation by IIT Kharagpur
resources.description: Lectures by Prof. Amitabha Bhattacharya covering dipole antennas, radiation patterns, antenna arrays, Friis transmission formula, and wave propagation.

resources.title: MIT 6.011 Signals, Systems and Inference
resources.description: MIT advanced course on state-space models, random processes, power spectral density, Wiener filtering, and Kalman filtering.

resources.title: All About Circuits Electrical & Electronics Textbook
resources.description: Open access comprehensive electronics educational portal covering DC/AC analysis, semiconductors, operational amplifiers, and digital ICs.

resources.title: NPTEL Wireless Communications by IIT Madras
resources.description: Prof. David Koilpillai lectures on cellular architecture, frequency reuse, multipath fading channels, diversity techniques, and OFDM.
